captions_en.fig:events: Cloud imagery, retrieved optical thickness and irradiance response for Niushou on 6 August 2025, initialized at 12:00 BJT. (a) Columns show +15, +120 and +240 min. Rows show observed AGRI, observed-image R-COT, SimVP-predicted AGRI and forecast-image R-COT, respectively. Composites use C03/C02/C01 and the same square-root display mapping over reflectance 0--1. Native 16$\times$16 pixels are retained; the cross and dashed box mark the station and its 3$\times$3 GHI input. (b) Station-pixel COT. (c) Observed target-ending 15-min GHI, the AGRI-plus-historical-COT baseline and a fixed residual mapping supplied with either forecast-image or observed-image COT. Predicted curves average three frozen-baseline source variants for display; missing labels remain gaps. The event was selected by calendar eligibility without inspecting errors. Future observations are offline diagnostic inputs, and R-COT is a retrieval proxy; values above its training reference range of 100 are retained. This development-date out-of-fold event does not establish independent forecast benefit.
captions_en.fig:three_station_event: Station-pixel COT (a--c) and GHI (d--f) at Niushou, Wangzhai and Mizhuang in the same calendar-selected event. Purple dashed curves use observed future AGRI-derived COT offline; orange solid curves use SimVP-derived COT. The same reference-trained residual mapping is used for the two GHI source evaluations. Gray is the existing AGRI-plus-historical-COT baseline, not a no-COT control. The stations have 13, 14 and 11 scored GHI intervals, respectively; missing intervals remain gaps. Within-row scales are shared. All source, aggregation and interpretation conventions follow the main event figure.
captions_en.fig:replacement: Sensitivity of a fixed irradiance mapping to image and COT sources. (a) Equal-station, equal-seed GHI RMSE on 8,111 common replacement rows from 12 development target dates (three stations, three seeds). All branches retain historical COT; “no future COT” removes only the additional future-COT correction input. (b) Replacing forecast AGRI with observed target-time AGRI in that control. (c) Adding source-matched future COT relative to the control with the same AGRI source. Intervals are 95\% paired target-date block bootstrap intervals (5,000 draws); the horizontal scales in (b) and (c) differ. Observed future AGRI and its retrieved COT are offline diagnostic inputs. These comparisons do not constitute independent evaluation or deployable forecast improvements.
captions_en.fig:probe: COT information under forecast and observed-image inputs. (a) GHI RMSE and paired differences from the frozen forecast baseline, which already uses historical COT. Context is a fixed linear residual probe using predicted AGRI, geometry, historical COT, lead and baseline output; the two augmented probes additionally receive future COT. (b) Reuse of the fitted probes under cross-substitution of the COT source. Entries are RMSE; parentheses give differences from the frozen baseline. The dashed inference column requires future observations. (c) Differences from the context probe by forecast horizon; 0--1 h includes +15 to +60 min. All panels use 32,838 common records from 50 development dates with date-block out-of-fold fitting. Scores average the station-specific RMSEs for three stations and three frozen-baseline sources equally. Whiskers are paired 95\% percentile intervals from 5,000 target-date-cluster bootstrap resamples. Observed-image COT is a frozen retrieval from actual future AGRI, used offline; it is neither independent cloud truth nor a deployable input. Negative differences indicate lower error.

captions_zh.fig:events: 2025年8月6日牛首站云图、反演光学厚度与辐照度响应，初始化为北京时间12:00。(a) 三列依次为+15、+120和+240 min；四行依次为真实AGRI、真实图反演R-COT、SimVP预测AGRI及预测图反演R-COT。合成图使用C03/C02/C01，统一采用反射率0–1上的平方根显示变换。保留原生16×16像元；十字和虚线框分别标记站点及其3×3 GHI输入。(b) 站点像元COT。(c) 以目标时刻为右端点的15分钟平均GHI观测、AGRI加历史COT基线，以及同一固定残差映射分别输入预测图COT和真实图COT的输出。预测曲线为三份冻结基线来源的展示均值，缺失标签保留断线。事件按日历有效性选择，未参考误差。未来观测只作离线诊断，R-COT是反演代理；超过训练参考范围100的输出予以保留。该开发日期折外案例不构成独立预报收益证据。
captions_zh.fig:three_station_event: 同一日历规则事件中牛首、王寨、米庄的站点像元COT（a–c）及GHI（d–f）。紫色虚线使用实际未来AGRI反演的COT，仅作离线诊断；橙色实线使用SimVP图像反演COT。两种GHI来源评估使用同一真实图COT训练的残差映射。灰色为已有AGRI加历史COT基线，并非无COT对照。三站分别有13、14、11个可评分GHI区间，缺项保持断线；每排共享坐标范围。来源、汇总与解释约定同主事件图。
captions_zh.fig:replacement: 固定辐照度映射对云图与COT来源的敏感性。(a) 12个开发目标日期、8,111条共同可替换样本，三个站点各三个种子的GHI RMSE分别计算后等权汇总。各分支均保留历史COT，“无未来COT”仅去除额外的未来COT修正输入。(b) 在该控制组中以真实目标时刻AGRI替换预测AGRI。(c) 相对相同AGRI来源的控制，加入来源匹配的未来COT。区间为5,000次目标日期块配对bootstrap的95%区间；(b)(c)横轴范围不同。未来真实AGRI及其反演COT仅供离线诊断，结果不构成独立评价或可部署预报收益。
captions_zh.fig:probe: 预测图与真实图输入下的COT信息。 (a) GHI RMSE及相对冻结预报基线的配对差值；该基线已使用历史COT。上下文组为固定线性残差探针，输入预测AGRI、几何、历史COT、时效和基线输出；另外两组加入未来COT。(b) 复用已拟合探针并交叉替换COT来源；单元格为RMSE，括号为相对冻结基线的差值，虚线框推理列需要未来观测。(c) 各预报时效区间相对上下文探针的差值，0–1 h包含+15至+60 min。所有面板使用50个开发日期的32,838条共同记录，按日期块做折外拟合。先对三站与三份冻结基线来源分别计算RMSE，再等权平均。误差线为5,000次目标日期簇bootstrap的配对95%百分位区间。真实图COT是冻结反演器处理实际未来AGRI得到的代理，只作离线诊断，既非独立云真值，也非可部署输入。负差值表示误差较低。
